hypothesis: Prior sign-only fixed-gross intents discard forecast amplitude and absolute risk sizing. Source forecast/10 times vol scalar, with source-default risk16percent and forecast-buffer10percent, may improve continuous economic efficiency. Test before any expansion, no forecast parameter grid.
calibration: Reuse frozen2024 mean-absolute raw forecast normalization; all prediction inputs lag one complete UTC day. No sizing parameter selected on2025/2026 returns. Existing history is consumed and diagnostic, not independentOOS.
selection_clock: Choose same up-to10names as prior sign-only intent using abs(clip(raw/2024norm,-3,3)) and prior threshold0.32; break ties alphabetically. Actual source-scaled forecasts then clip(raw/2024norm*10,-20,20). This preserves symbol selection and timing for a controlled sizing comparison.
absolute_sizing: For N selected names: average_notional_fraction=0.16/(sqrt365*max(relative_vol,0.001))/N; desired_fraction=average_notional_fraction*forecast/10. If sum(abs)>0.8, scale down only. Divide resulting fractions by0.8 to encode unit-gross inputs to the common engine. Never normalize weak signals back up to80percent gross.
buffering: Band halfwidth=0.10*average_notional_fraction, scaled down with any gross-cap reduction. Actual marked held weight drives nearest-band-edge target. Nonselected names have zero target/width. Stop/halt and hard gross limits override buffer; event-risk changes bypass buffer.
selection: 2025two-cost screen freezes3of5new sizing research profiles by minimum return, then lower worst drawdown, then name. Freeze best of3original static controls separately. Later cohort =3new profiles,cash,best_original_static,new3ruleequalmix; no downstream reselection.
budget: 20screen+24diagnostic+12capacity=56maximum accounts; no parameter grid or lower economic gates.
execution: Same resized account and cost/funding/capacity mechanics as prior56cases; only optional source-default actual-inventory forecast buffer is added in a versioned engine. All controls use this engine with buffer disabled; they must reproduce prior screen ledgers and metrics.
restart: Actual buffer state is held inventory; JSON resume preserves old highwater,halt,funding,pending exits,prices,config. No rule to restart a halted account or reset highwater.
changes_vs_previous: Source default annual risk16percent and cap20 are mathematical references, not full source performance reproduction. Crypto uses365 instead of business days, common robust35dayvol/floor instead of upstream current mixedvol, top10liquid pool instead of private source instruments, fixed2024scale instead of future-backfilled estimates, common0.8gross/no leverage/8percent stop/15percent hardhalt.
